line 441-447 is a single 71-word sentence covering the shock, the consumer's response, the saving decision, the future taxes and the government's bond issuance; 449 is 51 words, 753-757 is 59 words, 269-273 is 46, 101 is 42, 94 is 40 and 774-777 is 39 - the pattern is one sentence per causal chain instead of one sentence per link, and every one of these splits at a comma into two or three sentences
